added.title: Director, Product Marketing
added.description:
Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you’re blocked.

We’re here to give power to the patient.

For nearly 20 years, we’ve built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we’re going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc’s marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more.

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting . We don’t want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking.

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started.

Your Impact on Our Mission

As the Director of Patient Product Marketing, you'll be the strategic voice of the patient inside Zocdoc's Product Marketing organization. Reporting to our VP, Product Marketing, you'll own the overarching positioning, narrative, and GTM strategy for the entire patient-facing portfolio–defining how millions of consumers discover, choose, and come to trust Zocdoc. In this role, you will lead and scale a high-performing team of PMMs, pairing deep market insights with visionary audience strategies that accelerate customer adoption and long-term business growth. By staying ahead of where healthcare is going, you’ll paint a clear picture of the future for patients while helping to shape our product strategy. You will lead our PMM team into an AI-native era—championing automated GTM workflows and modern tool stacks that allow the team to scale efficiently and focus on high-impact work.

Your day-to-day is...

Owning go-to-market strategy and positioning across our consumer portfolio, serving as strategic partner to design, product, and GMs, and bringing a sharp perspective on the exact consumer segments we should build for
Leading and coaching a team of PMMs, setting the standard for audience strategy, messaging simplicity, and high-impact GTM execution
Informing the product discovery with market context, validating user needs and competitive dynamics to ensure our roadmaps deliver clear patient value and strong product-market fit
Championing the shift toward scalable GTM capabilities and AI-native ways of working to maximize business impact

You'll Enjoy This Role If You...

Love turning complex user behaviors into clear, compelling positioning and GTM strategy
Are energized by building and coaching a team of product marketers
Can speak with equal fluency to a GM about market opportunity and to a product team about patient psychology and user experience
Have an interest in transforming the healthcare experience for millions of patients
Are comfortable being the accountable owner of a narrative that spans multiple products and teams
Take pride in balancing big-picture strategy with the coaching and rigor it takes to bring a team along with you

You'll be successful in this role if you...

Have 12–15+ years of relevant marketing experience, including 8+ years in product marketing and demonstrated success building and leading teams, including people managers
Have deep experience with consumer products or marketplaces, ideally where trust, choice, and repeat engagement drive the business
Have a track record of shaping company-level narrative and positioning, not just individual product launches
Are a systematic coach who uses structured approaches to assess talent, build development plans, and recruit outside talent
Can navigate ambiguity and competing priorities, making sound tradeoffs with incomplete information
Are an exceptional communicator who can translate complex or sensitive topics for senior leaders and represent the function in high-visibility conversations
Have applied external market and industry insight to sharpen positioning and drive performance

Benefits

Flexible, hybrid work environment at our convenient Soho location
Unlimited Vacation
100% paid employee health benefit options (including medical, dental, and vision)
Commuter Benefits
401(k) with employer funded match
Corporate wellness program with Wellhub
Sabbatical leave (for employees with 5+ years of service)
Competitive paid parental leave and fertility/family planning reimbursement
Cell phone reimbursement
Catered lunch everyday along with beverages and snacks
Employee Resource Groups and ZocClubs to promote shared community and belonging
Great Place to Work Certified

Zocdoc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Salary ranges are determined through alignment with market data. Base salary offered is determined by a number of factors including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and skills. Certain positions are also eligible for variable pay and/or equity; your recruiter will discuss the full compensation package details.

NYC Base Salary Range

$210,000—$270,000 USD

About Us

Zocdoc is the country’s leading digital health marketplace that helps patients easily find and book the care they need. Each month, millions of patients use our free service to find nearby, in-network providers, compare choices based on verified patient reviews, and instantly book in-person or video visits online. Providers participate in Zocdoc’s Marketplace to reach new patients to grow their practice, fill their last-minute openings, and deliver a better healthcare experience. Founded in 2007 with a mission to give power to the patient, our work each day in pursuit of that mission is guided by our six core values. Zocdoc is a private company backed by some of the world’s leading investors, and we believe we’re still only scratching the surface of what we plan to accomplish.

Zocdoc is a mission-driven organization dedicated to building teams as diverse as the patients and providers we aim to serve. In the spirit of one of our core values - Together, Not Alone , we are a company that prides itself on being highly collaborative, and we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences and contributors make our community and our platform better. We’re an equal opportunity employer committed to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Applicants are considered for employment regardless of race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, national origin, gender, sex, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or parental status, disability, veteran status, or any other class protected by applicable laws.

added.title: Senior Product Manager, Mobile, DV+
added.description:
Los Angeles, CA

San Francisco, CA

New York, NY

Hybrid Schedule (M/F remote, T/W/TH in-office)

At Magnite, we cultivate an environment of continuous growth and collaboration. Our work impacts what millions of people read, watch, and buy, and we’re looking for people to help us tackle that responsibility with creativity and focus. Magnite (NASDAQ: MGNI) is the world’s largest independent sell-side advertising platform. Publishers use our technology to monetize their content across all screens and formats including CTV / streaming, online video, display, and audio. Our tech fuels billions of transactions per day!

The Senior Product Manager, Mobile, DV+, will help define and execute against Magnite’s Mobile in-app strategy. This role serves to help Magnite strengthen its position as the industry-leading omnichannel SSP by expanding our mobile capabilities within the DV+ platform and drive further adoption of our Mobile SDK. The ideal candidate will also be a subject matter expert and Mobile evangelist within the organization, educating and supporting internal team members about the nuances of Mobile in-app advertising and leading cross-functional initiatives to grow the Mobile business.

In This Role You Will

Serve as product owner for key Mobile initiatives across the Magnite DV+ platform
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Revenue teams to execute and deliver product investments to drive Magnite’s Mobile strategy
Generate ideas for new product investments based on an understanding of the Mobile app ad ecosystem, Magnite’s core strengths and the broader competitive landscape
Work closely with our Technical Operations, Product Marketing, and Account Management teams to drive adoption of your products and features
Collect and synthesize feedback from customers, partners, and vendors who are integrated into our digital advertising ecosystem
Manage product prioritization and trade-offs, balancing quick wins with longer-term, more strategic product investments
Prepare product documentation, communications, release notes, training materials, and other go-to-market deliverables
Leverage modern AI tools and emerging technologies to design scalable solutions, automate workflows, and improve operational efficiency

We’re Looking For Someone With

A Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience
6+ years of experience in product management in the digital advertising space, with 3+ years specifically focused on Mobile in-app advertising
Proven experience managing SDK products and integrations with publishers and mediation platforms within the mobile ad tech ecosystem
Technical fluency necessary to understand SDK architectures and developer pain points
Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with customers, external ecosystem partners, internal teams, and senior management
Experience in driving elements of the product development lifecycle including product roadmapping, product requirements, go-to-market planning, and end-of-life planning
Experience working with cross-functional teams (especially, Engineering, Project Management, Technical Operations, and Sales/Account Management/Business Development)
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills; comfortable accessing, manipulating, analyzing, and presenting data
A demonstrated track record of shipping products in a high-growth environment

In San Francisco, the base salary range for this role is $175,000 – $195,000.

In New York, the base salary range for this role is $175,000 – $195,000.

In Los Angeles, the base salary range for this role is $155,000 – $175,000.

Actual compensation will be determined based on location, experience, skills, and internal equity.

This Role Is Also Eligible For

Annual performance-based bonus
Equity (NASDAQ: MGNI)
Comprehensive benefits package

During the interview process, candidates will receive more specific information about the salary range applicable to their experience and location.

Perks And Benefits

Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage from Day One
Generous Time Off
Holiday Breaks and Quarterly Wellness Days
Equity and Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Family-Focused Benefits and Parental Leave
401k Retirement Savings Plan with Employer Match
Disability and Life Insurance
Cell Phone Subsidy
Monthly Fitness and Reimbursement

Career Growth

We support internal mobility, skill development, and leadership pathways through structured career frameworks and learning programs.

Company Culture

Magnite’s culture is rooted in collaboration and connection, recognizing that both are essential to success. Our hybrid schedule includes two remote workdays (Monday and Friday) and three in-office days (Tuesday through Thursday), where employees can take advantage of catered lunches, beverages, snacks, training opportunities, and engaging office events that enhance the work experience. In addition, we support our team through meaningful benefits and programs, including community service and volunteer opportunities, company-matched charitable contributions, access to mental health resources, structured career development initiatives and growth frameworks, culture and inclusion programs, and our Bonusly peer-to-peer recognition platform.

About Us

The world's leading agencies and brands trust our platform to access brand-safe, high-quality ad inventory and execute billions of advertising transactions each month. Anchored in bustling New York City, sunny Los Angeles, mile-high Denver, historic London, and down under in Sydney, Magnite has offices across North America, EMEA, LATAM, and APAC.

For Los Angeles-based Applicants

Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

Job Duties

The material job duties of this specific job position for which Magnite reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship include:

Having access to the Company’s Confidential Information or trade secrets including data related to customers, clients, vendors, business partners, or suppliers
Work with cross teams to access datasets, databases, formulas, algorithms, tools, products, prototypes, systems applications, and technologies in any stage of development

Magnite is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against applicants due to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other federal, state or local protected class.

Our Commitment: We aim to incorporate a wide range of voices into our Magnite culture, cultivating an environment where employees feel welcomed, cared for, and encouraged to freely share ideas. We are committed to employee growth, collaboration, inclusion, and innovation. We invest in Magnite’s local communities. We seek talent from all backgrounds to champion corporate values of seeing the big picture and being catalysts of change.

Want to learn more about us?

Check out our blog for Magnite announcements and Ad Tech industry news!

Recruiting Agency Notice

Magnite does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

added.title: Senior Manager - Global New Product Introduction (NPI) - Systems Hardware
added.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, we know time is the most critical facet in the laboratory today:  time to get life-saving therapies to patients faster; reclaiming time by automating tedious manual workflows; and saving time spent addressing erroneous or complex results.

We are partners in time and accelerate answers to critical questions through the power of automation. We develop innovations for scientists by scientists, with many of our 3,300+ global colleagues coming from the laboratory.

It’s all part of our time-tested approach to bringing meaningful innovations at the speed of life since 1935. And we’re just beginning. Working together, let’s put our time and talents together to advance human health for tomorrow.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Senior Manager - Global New Product Introduction (NPI)
- Systems Hardware is responsible for leading Manufacturing Engineering and Operations readiness for hardware- and systems-based product development programs across Beckman Coulter Life Sciences' global manufacturing network. This leader serves as the critical bridge between R&D, Product Management, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Service, and Manufacturing Operations to ensure successful design transfer, manufacturing scale-up, and on-time commercialization of complex life science instrumentation.

This position reports to the Director, Manufacturing Engineering and is part of the Global Manufacturing Engineering & Innovation organization located in Indianapolis, Indiana. This will be an on-site role with global collaboration across U.S., China, and Europe BEC LS manufacturing and development locations as required.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To

Lead Manufacturing Engineering engagement from product concept through commercialization for hardware and instrument platforms, ensuring safety, quality, delivery, cost, supply continuity, reliability, capacity, and launch objectives are achieved.
Lead governance for the global hardware NPI portfolio, including milestones, resource prioritization, capital plans, risk management, escalation paths, launch metrics, executive reviews, and post-launch stabilization.
Partner with the Director, Manufacturing Engineering to develop and deploy global NPI and manufacturing engineering strategies aligned with business growth, product roadmaps, manufacturing footprint, capacity, lifecycle, and innovation priorities.
Ensure robust design transfer and manufacturing readiness across U.S., China, and Europe locations, including manufacturing requirements, process development, equipment and tooling, pilot builds, test methods, documentation, process validation, production ramp, and issue closure.
Drive Design for Manufacturing, Assembly, Test, Service, Reliability, and Cost in partnership with R&D and other functions, using the Danaher Business System, standard work, visual management, value stream mapping, daily management, kaizen, and structured problem solving.
Lead selected global manufacturing excellence initiatives involving engineering standards, process capability, automation, digital manufacturing, manufacturing technology, test strategy, productivity, value engineering, and continuous cost improvement.
Lead and develop managers, engineers, and technical project leaders across a global matrix; strengthen accountability, technical capability, talent reviews, succession planning, leadership development, inclusion, and mobility across global and site teams.

The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include

Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Biomedical, Electrical, Manufacturing, Systems, or a closely related engineering discipline.
Typically 10+ years of progressive experience across engineering, manufacturing, operations, product development, and/or new product introduction.
At least 5 years of people leadership experience, with demonstrated ability to lead managers, engineers, or technical project leaders across locations or in a global matrix. Working knowledge of FDA, ISO, quality-system, design-control, risk-management, verification and validation, change-control, traceability, process-validation, and product-lifecycle requirements.
Demonstrated success launching complex electromechanical, software-enabled, diagnostic, medical device, or life science instrumentation products in regulated manufacturing environments.
Deep experience with design transfer, industrialization, manufacturing readiness, process development and validation, manufacturing test, tooling and equipment, supplier readiness, ramp, and lifecycle support.
Proven ability to translate business and product strategy into engineering priorities, operating mechanisms, investment recommendations, and measurable results. Experience leading portfolio governance, resource prioritization, capital planning, risk reviews, and cross-functional executive decision-making.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

Master’s degree in engineering, an MBA, PMP certification, Lean Six Sigma certification, or comparable advanced development.
Experience with flow cytometry, centrifugation, liquid handling, particle characterization, genomics, bioprocessing, or comparable scientific instrumentation platforms.
Experience leading global engineering transformation, automation, digital manufacturing, connected equipment, manufacturing data systems, or advanced analytics initiatives.
Experience with site transfers, localization, manufacturing footprint changes, contract manufacturers, supplier development, acquisition integration, or rapid capacity expansion.

Beckman Coulter Life Sciences, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info.

At Beckman Coulter Life Sciences we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Beckman Coulter Life Sciences can provide.

This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

added.title: Senior Product Manager
added.description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are…

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your New Role...

We are seeking a skilled and motivated Sr. Product Manager to join our team and lead the development and enhancement of our personalization services on HBO Max. As a Sr. Product Manager, you will play a pivotal role in defining the product strategy, driving innovation, and delivering exceptional user experiences. Your expertise and leadership will guide the direction of personalized and automated recommendations, ensuring they remain at the forefront of industry trends and customer expectations.

Your efforts will help us scale to >100m customers and become the leading streaming company. You will identify and quantify customer problems, determine approaches to address them, and A/B test different features to solve them. You will be part of a team of Product Managers focused on Personalization, working closely with Software Engineers and Data Scientists.

The team has a diverse range of skill sets, experience in AI, Machine Learning, Recommenders, related fields across streaming media, e-commerce, and from top-flight tech firms. You will partner with Editorial and Marketing professionals and discuss regularly with company executives.

Your Role Accountabilities...

We’re seeking a seasoned Sr. Product Manager to lead personalization efforts at WBD. This role is central to our mission to create intelligent, adaptive, and trusted experiences across HBO Max. The ideal candidate has deep experience with ML-driven recommendation at scale, thrives in technically complex ecosystems, and is equally fluent in data science, user behavior, and business impact.
As a key contributor for personalization at WBD, you will:
Define Strategy:
Own the end-to-end product strategy for ML-powered personalization and discovery. Identify opportunities that align with WBD’s strategic goals and improve engagement, retention, and customer satisfaction.
Drive Roadmap:
Lead roadmap development for personalization systems, coordinating closely with engineering, data science, UX, and content teams to prioritize initiatives that balance innovation, quality, and speed.
Evolve the User Experience:
Champion customer-centricity by leveraging experimentation, user research, and behavioral data to design and optimize personalized experiences across surfaces.
Orchestrate Systems Thinking:
Manage complex ranking systems and feedback loops. Understand how data (user signals, content metadata) flows through algorithms and influences outcomes across product surfaces.
Stakeholder Leadership:
Partner with executives, engineering leaders, data teams, and content strategists to align roadmaps, communicate outcomes, and translate vision into action.
Benchmark and Differentiate:
Monitor trends in personalization, ML tooling, and competitors’ discovery experiences to inform roadmap priorities and strategic pivots.
Measure Impact:
Define KPIs that align with both user value and business metrics (e.g., engagement, diversity, and relevance). Use experimentation and analytics to optimize performance and guide iteration.
Launch & Iterate:
Lead go-to-market for personalization & recommendation capabilities, ensuring internal readiness, high-quality rollout, and learning-based iteration cycles.

Qualifications & Experience...

5+ years of product management experience, with significant time spent on ML-driven products or content discovery systems.
Proven track record of shipping consumer-facing personalization or recommendation systems at scale.
Strong technical fluency—able to engage meaningfully with engineering and data science on ranking models, data pipelines, AI, and ML evaluation.
Deep understanding of A/B testing methodologies, statistical analysis, and product experimentation frameworks.
Systems thinker who can connect the dots between algorithmic performance, customer experience treatments, and business outcomes.
Excellent communicator who can synthesize complexity for a range of audiences, from executives to junior engineers.
Experience leading cross-functional teams in agile environments; familiarity with tools like Jira and Confluence.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (preferred but not required).

How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.

In compliance with local law, we are disclosing the compensation, or a range thereof, for roles in locations where legally required. Actual salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, skill set, experience, and/or performance. Base pay is just one component of Warner Bros. Discovery’s total compensation package for employees. Pay Range: $126,000.00 - $234,000.00 salary per year. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, short- and long-term incentives, and program-specific awards. In addition, Warner Bros. Discovery provides a variety of benefits to employees, including health insurance coverage, an employee wellness program, life and disability insurance, a retirement savings plan, paid holidays and sick time and vacation.

If you’re a qualified candidate with an arrest or conviction record, please know that your application will be considered in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.
